development: N64 coarse scan plus historical Stage5 states used to develop diagnostics; not a blind protocol for those data. Frozen before inspecting critical N96/128 interior/upper refinement fits.
stopping: Exact installed TeNPy Delta_E/max(E,1), absoluteDelta_S; solver stopping, chi agreement, independent initial-chain agreement and N trends all reported separately

antiphase.notes: Oscillatory raw plateau or exponentialxi pegged at bound, nonzero ordered profile allowed; connected subtraction can remove order

floating.requires: Converged independent N128 chi256 initial chains, chi128 control, and N96 trend. If not all met, candidate or crossover_unresolved rather than supported.

paramagnetic.requires: ConsistentNtrend and convergedchi/init; modulated q allowed

transition_intervals: Bracket supported sampled sides; unresolved samples remain explicit. No closest-reference-line pairing; no claim of precise thermodynamic critical fields.
K_missing_policy: Missing/low-amplitude/poor fit/at-bound K is unavailable; no expected K imputation; fitted ZZ exponent is never renamedK
followup: Contradiction near lowerwindow ->.3125/.3375; upperwindow ->.45/.475/.4875, largerN160/192 only after coarse/refined information warrants it; keep both sides within remaining MPS budget
